text.finding: Each of the 239 Addis filters with a baselined spectrum is scored by its best Pearson r against McCall's charred feedstock (r_char) and its raw feedstock (r_raw); delta = r_raw − r_char. Within McCall raw biomass is the closer analogue for most filters, and the margin is largest in the dry season, where similarity to char collapses into a distinct low-similarity population (a two-component Gaussian mixture on r_char, fitted without the season) that recurs every October–February and is not the filter lot or the loading. The full charcoal library still matches Addis better than either McCall class (furnace charcoal r ≈ 0.78), so none of this says Addis is unburned biomass.
